name: Ministering
overview: Scripture reveals ministering as a divine calling empowered by Christ's authority, entrusted to various roles such as apostles, prophets, evangelists, pastors, and teachers to faithfully proclaim the gospel and nurture believers. Ministering involves both testifying to the grace of God and encouraging one another through teaching and worship, reflecting the light of Christ so that others may glorify God. Additionally, ministering extends beyond human effort, as even ministering spirits serve those destined for salvation, underscoring the spiritual dimension of this work.
